headline: Project IGI - the cyber cafe favourite
title: Project IGI Memories | I'm Going In | Classic Games
video_script: Project IGI, short for I'm Going In, came out in two thousand. It was made by Innerloop Studios from Norway. You play David Jones, a trained commando who infiltrates enemy bases on his own. In India it was a cyber cafe favourite, and lots of players still remember its very first mission. How many times did you play IGI? Comment below!
description: Project IGI (I'm Going In, 2000) by Innerloop Studios (Norway) - David Jones' story, and an Indian cyber cafe favourite.
